title: The Crooked Hollow Anew
author: Coral Winterbourne
blurb: Mara Quintana, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
